correctness.rationale: Beta-integral monomial norm, closed reciprocal moment formula, torus symmetry at the origin and exact fourth-order derivatives reconstruct the full coordinate curvature tensor. The sectional quartic is strictly negative for every nonzero tangent vector by weighted Cauchy-Schwarz, while the transverse bisectional entries are positive. Explicit lifted disk automorphisms carry results to every point of the analytic spine. The standalone rational checker was run and passed five parameter families; finite checks are only supplementary.

value.rationale: The geometric problem of negative holomorphic sectional curvature coexisting with positive bisectional curvature is directly motivated by Cho–Yuan 2020. The theorem supplies a natural bounded convex Reinhardt family in all complex dimensions at least three, a complete tensor and an exact all-transverse positive coefficient at every point of a distinguished analytic orbit, rather than an arbitrary isolated numeric slice. It does not assert global curvature pinching.
